full_details: In the morning Gib lay on Golding's Ovid, and you copied no line out of him. At half past eleven Richard Field called. Harrison means to put Venus out again, small, in octavo, a book for a pocket, and not a penny in it for you. You said you were glad to be thought portable. He asked after a third poem. The press stands idle on Fridays. An apprentice says the comedy is the talk of the Inns. Field does not hold with it, and he asked to borrow the book when Garnish can spare it. He will lay by two quires of Rochelle crown at fourpence halfpenny the quire. He asked after your father in Henley Street. You had no newer word than mending. You paid nothing for the paper on the call. At dinner you told the house the reprint as news. The Sunday letter is still folded for tomorrow.
one_sentence: Richard Field called from the Blackfriars about a smaller Venus, and you were glad to be thought portable.
title: A smaller Venus, glad to be thought portable
